stated_limitation: The dataset's own LinearizedTimeSeries is valid for only ~7% of samples, but the raw x-coordinate of the tracked position correlates with it at r > 0.9999 and is valid for 97% of samples

justification.dataset: 000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki CA1) with a PRE/MAZE/POST linear-track session is the canonical hippocampal-replay dataset.
justification.handling: Real streaming from DANDI S3 with correct epochs, states, unit/cell-type filtering, and careful contiguous-bout splitting to avoid a real position artifact.
justification.analysis: Bayesian decoding with a correct within-event column-cycle shuffle is sound, but the headline PRE-vs-POST comparison has no between-group test and the ~9% PRE rate hints the null may be anticonservative.
justification.correctness: Reported fractions and scores reproduce exactly from the committed CSVs and are internally consistent and physically valid.
justification.figures: Place-field map, textbook SWR trace, sequential decoded-trajectory examples, and a labeled summary all clearly show the phenomenon with units and sample sizes.
justification.honesty: The write-up calls a non-significant difference (Fisher p=0.21) 'significantly more often' and 'the classic signature of hippocampal replay' with no between-group test and no limitations section, an unsupported quantitative claim that caps this axis at 1.
justification.verdict: The pipeline and above-chance POST replay are genuinely solid, but the central experience-dependence claim is overstated and untested, so it needs a proportion test and reframing before being believed.
